performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real and 3-day worsening; creative refresh is the structural fix.

findings.text: ROAS fell 35.24% in 7d on flat spend (+0.04%); last 3 days (Sep 10–12) show 1 purchase and $629.84 revenue vs prior 3 days (Sep 7–9) 8 purchases and $1,142.00 — confirmed deterioration accelerating.
Overdue: Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (Aug 14), Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test + UTM, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails — all missed Aug 31 deadline, blocking attribution and creative pipeline.
GBP actions dropped 66.21% in 7d; last 3 days show 0 GBP actions (Sep 10–12) vs 19–26/day prior week — organic demand signal has gone dark, compounding paid weakness.

Top campaign 'BWS - Sales - Muslims' consumed $836.98 (57% of 28d spend) with IG reach down 11.54% and declining daily (625→581 last 2 days) on flat spend — classic frequency-driven creative fatigue pattern.
GA4 sessions held 250–285 last 3 days while purchases collapsed to 0–1/day; conversion rate is the gap, pointing to a landing page or checkout friction issue, not just traffic.

suggestions.text: Inject new real-footage creative into BWS - Sales - Muslims; rotate minimum 2 fresh ads to counter confirmed fatigue and IG reach decline to 581.
suggestions.monday_update: ROAS dropped 35.24% in 7 days and IG reach fell to 581 on the top campaign ($836.98 spend, 57% of budget), confirming creative fatigue. Pull in at least 2 new real-footage or facility-footage ads from the July 21 Haney Drive delivery and launch them into this ad set this week. Success check: ROAS stabilises at or above 3.5x and daily reach recovers above 700 within 7 days (by 2026-09-20).

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions recovery; 0 actions for 3 consecutive days (Sep 10–12) warrants escalation if still dark by Sep 16.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for the last 3 days (Sep 10–12) after a 66.21% weekly decline — this removes a key local demand signal. No paid action is appropriate yet, but if GBP remains at zero actions through Sep 16, escalate to ops to check profile status and local listing health. Success check: GBP actions return above 15/day by 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Close the Funnel Test + UTM milestone (overdue Aug 31); 0 UTM data blocks Windsor reconciliation and obscures true ROAS attribution.
suggestions.monday_update: The Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live milestone missed its Aug 31 deadline and remains open. Without UTM data, Windsor cannot reconcile Meta's 7-day-click attribution against Shopify, making the current 4.92 ROAS figure unverifiable. Nacer to confirm owner and set a hard close date no later than 2026-09-17. Success check: UTM parameters firing on all paid landing pages confirmed in Windsor by 2026-09-17.
